wl.class_origin_desc: Foundational grid. The base signal state.
wl.classes_p: 88 public passes, 11 CWI reserve (contributors, partnerships, treasury — disclosed before mint). One public pass per wallet during allowlist.
wl.demand_p: Every waitlist signup is a public GitHub issue with the
wl.demand_p2: label. The count below is rendered from that live data — no likes, no impressions, no invented numbers.
wl.equal_body: One contract, one membership promise. Visual rarity may vary, but access rights do not — rarity is never a promise of greater economic value. Do not mistake a rare look for a better deal.

wl.footer_legal: Blueprint: internal planning document — all collection numbers are planning assumptions, not forecasts. Not legal, tax, or investment advice. No mint, sale, or wallet transaction is authorized by this page.
wl.gate_body: There is no mint date. There will not be one until the demand gate passes: 75 qualified waitlist members. Until then, this page only collects real interest — counted publicly, below. Zero is a number.
wl.kicker: 99-PASS PILOT · WAITLIST OPEN · MINT DATE: NONE
wl.launch_1: Immediate access to the Founding Signal welcome pack
wl.launch_2: First community vote within seven days of mint close
wl.launch_3: First private Signal Brief within 14 days
wl.launch_4: First digital Studio Drop within 30 days
wl.lede: A utility-first digital membership pilot. Not a speculative collectible — a membership experience with an on-chain receipt. The token makes access portable and collectible; CWI's execution makes it valuable.
wl.qualified_note: "Qualified" means the member confirmed wallet readiness and utility interest — raw interest counts above; qualification is tallied during validation. The gate stays closed until 75 qualified members are recorded.
wl.ready_p: One issue per person. Pick the class that speaks to you — or no preference. Tell us why. We'll count it in the open.
wl.thesis_p1: The winning product is not "an NFT." It is a CWI membership experience with an on-chain receipt. Ninety-nine passes are enough to test conversion and engagement without creating a large, unsupported supply.
wl.thesis_promise: Plain-language promise: "This is a collectible CWI membership pass. It provides the benefits listed on the official utility page while CWI operates the program. It is not an investment and does not include music, royalty, equity, or intellectual-property rights."
wl.updated_at: updated {ts} (UTC) · source: open GitHub issues labeled "waitlist"
wl.utility_note: Every benefit has an owner, a cadence, and a fulfillment cost. After mint, a public utility ledger will show each benefit's status, delivery date, evidence link, and next scheduled occurrence. This calendar activates only if the mint happens.
